item.title: Phoenix businesses join nationwide 'ICE Out' to protest immigration raids
item.description: Several local businesses across the Valley will close their doors Friday, Jan. 30, as part of a nationwide "ICE Out" shutdown to protest recent federal immigration operations.Organizers and community members gathered Thursday night to discuss the strike, which calls for a day of no work, no school, and no shopping.
